- unique targetChapters: 6, 9, 10
- id: MAP-044F075AE6
- assessment: designed

- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:340-378: Position specs flatten HK/US channels, preserve contract/currency/quantity/marketValue, and omit zero quantity.
- currentBehavior: getPositions loops channels, drops zero rows, deduplicates symbols and returns flat Position[] without accountChannel, scope, observedAt or provenance.
- problem: Same symbol across channels can merge; zero observations proving a close disappear; compatibility output has no schema/quality evidence.
- targetModel: The positions leaf returns scoped ExposureObservation rows keyed by canonical instrument and raw channel, including signed quantity and valid zero rows. Position[] is only a compatibility projection, and read observation durability is separate from order execution WAL.
- pureTransitions:
  - decodePositionResponse(raw, scopeDirectory) -&gt; Result&lt;ExposureObservation[], PositionSchemaFailure|ScopeDiscoveryPending&gt; retaining channel.
  - foldExposure(previous,observation) -&gt; ExposureSnapshot keyed by scope/instrument/channel.
  - toLegacyPosition(snapshot) -&gt; Position[] filters only for presentation and records omission reason.
- effectBoundary: stockPositions/enrichment are Effects; channel identity, signed arithmetic and zero filtering are pure after decode. Channel and zero-row observations are projection facts. Their cursor/sequence/cache durability is not order WAL, and a data reader never runs prepare/approve/compensate.
- durability: Persist channel key and sequence; a zero row advances the projection and closes exposure. Never dedup by display symbol before canonical identity. Read/cache persistence is separate from order WAL, approval, dispatch, and compensation.
- errors:
  - PositionSchemaFailure({channel,field}) -&gt; affected-row failure.
  - ScopeConflict -&gt; retain separate scopes or reject.
  - InstrumentUnresolved -&gt; incomplete, not tradeable.
- preservedBehavior:
  - Keep valid nonzero long/short and market values.
  - Retain zero in authority while compatibility UI may omit it.
- replacementSteps:
  - Decode channels into scoped observations.
  - Dedup only after identity+scope.
  - Add same-symbol multi-channel and zero-close coverage.
- verificationCases:
  - HK and US same ticker remain distinct.
  - Zero row closes prior exposure in journal but yields no display row.
  - Malformed channel scope is failure, not empty list.
- openQuestions: —
- review: accepted — LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:340-378 shows channels flattened and zero rows omitted. The entry now preserves raw accountChannel plus resolved scope, records zero as closing evidence, and rejects scope ambiguity instead of merging symbols.

## Cross-group contracts

- The Longbridge pack exposes a conceptual provider capability tree whose leaves each declare exact input/output/error schemas, delivery (finite pull or scoped stream when actually available), effect category, resources, and availability. The fixed UTA-facing CapabilityDescriptor is shared; there is no global ActionContractMap, universal IBroker method product, or Unsupported-filled handler set (MAP-E02EBB0CE2, MAP-312213403A, MAP-965560EC86).
- AccountScope is AccountId plus explicit SubAccountId for account-owned capabilities and order facts: balances, positions, order observations, native account lookup descriptors, conflict keys, and controlled effect plans. Public Instrument/Candle/News-style data uses Public or an exact provider-declared scope and never invents a wallet or subaccount; the one-relationship source comment does not prove a single executable wallet (MAP-F105D05B4C, MAP-044F075AE6, MAP-FCDA99890A).
- Order leaves use semantic Order data plus composable schema/HOF extensions. Units versus Notional and any variant restrictions are Longbridge-provider declarations, not global cross-provider rules; trailing amount versus percent, expiry-bearing TIF, SessionPolicy, protection, parent/OCA, and native fields are preserved exactly or return named unavailable. Only a transaction-wrapped effect uses WAL/CAS/idempotency/observe/recovery (MAP-E1A5D342A5, MAP-9218DFF430, MAP-4472AC0A90).
- Public/account data-unit leaves for Longbridge account, position, quote/depth, static-info, FX, catalog, and session pulls use their declared scope and explicit quality, cursor/lifecycle, freshness, and gap evidence. Data readers/caches do not run order prepare/approval/compensation or per-frame WAL; selected decision evidence is copied explicitly when an account-owned order consumes it (MAP-4E3338B271, MAP-F91287463C, MAP-C6EFEC85F5).
- Native instrument identity is suffix/venue/jurisdiction/currency/kind evidence, not a compatibility Contract or currency inference. SH and SZ remain distinct; unknown suffix/market/derivative/status/TIF values remain raw protocol evidence and never become US, STK, LMT, DAY, or Submitted defaults (MAP-F2F4CA1A39, MAP-C9E3109EB0, MAP-D77E448B20).
- Connection reach, account permission, capability, policy, and preconditions remain distinct. Paper/live and endpoint/account claims require observed evidence; RuntimeHealth and recovery gates are not granted by a broker probe, and no native release/idempotency/atomicity guarantee is invented (MAP-50CE86A3DE, MAP-4DE673DCFE, MAP-39CF059275).

## Additional findings

- LongbridgeBroker.ts:1-16 describes one multi-market relationship and a no-FxService HKD-only fallback, while foldBalancesToBase:393-408 actually selects HKD or the largest netAssets bucket. The target preserves every account-scoped currency bucket and represents valuation quality separately; the source fact does not establish one wallet or a base-total guarantee.
- longbridge-types.ts:1-8 describes getter-only Rust-NAPI classes and only a read subset. Structural TypeScript interfaces are therefore not runtime schemas; native codecs must validate getter presence, values, response version, and field paths at each provider leaf (MAP-1B0A73A8CA, MAP-DE6DDE18C3).
- longbridge-contracts.ts:1-8 states that suffix is the unique key and bare 700 is ambiguous across boards, but the implementation supplies .US/SH fallbacks. The target treats suffix/catalog evidence as identity input and keeps SH/SZ distinct (MAP-F2F4CA1A39, MAP-C517435305, MAP-C9E3109EB0).
- LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:828-843 provides a toString-only Decimal helper and default-zero balance fixtures. These remain useful pure fixture evidence, but do not prove native response schema, missing-vs-zero behavior, independent remote outcomes, or crash recovery (MAP-B35B59A740, MAP-7805D80DA1).
- LongbridgeBroker.ts:230-233 implements close as an async no-op and cites garbage collection for Rust handles. The target records cleanup evidence as unavailable unless a native hook is observed; scoped ownership and closed-generation behavior are design constraints, not a claim that GC is deterministic (MAP-39CF059275).
- LongbridgeBroker.ts:567-573 uses stockDerivatives ?? [], conflating a missing field with an explicit empty derivative list. The schema leaf preserves field presence so EquityLike/Unresolved remain distinct and no instrument capability is broadened (MAP-6D6AB93685, MAP-6BEB2F95EE).
- fx-service.ts:140-204 can expose cached/default and unknown-currency 1:1 rates with warning-only provenance. Longbridge valuation therefore retains FxObservation source/time/freshness and blocks Exact execution decisions for disallowed Estimated/Unknown values (MAP-E45F535798, MAP-2EDFABE32A).
- The source IBroker/global switch is an investigation fact only. The corrected target registers Longbridge-specific schema leaves and an interpreter behind the fixed CapabilityDescriptor boundary; account scope is required only for account-owned leaves, while public data remains public/provider-scoped. Adding a future native field must not modify a kernel capability switch or force unrelated providers to implement it (K01, K02, MAP-E02EBB0CE2).
